conviction_note: Nothing company-level the market has not seen: the weak Q1 (OP progress 12% vs a ~21% five-year norm, orders -12.7%, backlog -9.9%) is public and was sold -7.9% in July, and the company called it on plan. The only open item is whether it cuts the FY plan at this print, as it did at last year's Q2 (-11.5% reaction). Against that sit a deliberately back-loaded plan (interim dividend cut 28->22 yen at the April guide) and last year's record of hitting its initial plan (6,300 initial, 6,346 actual) after cutting it. So the findings net to about -0.2 and the scaled number is a mild lean, p_up 47 on a ~5.5% scale, giving -0.33. The two measurements agree in sign and roughly in size.
bar: Company FY27/3 plan: revenue 60,000m yen, OP 6,600m, ordinary 6,800m, DPS 70 (22 interim + 48 year-end), held unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260728500918.pdf). No H1 forecast is disclosed. There is no street number: the IFIS consensus is empty (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4832, 2026-10-27) and Shikiho was not reachable. So the bar is the company plan only, and the sizes are capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is a probability-weighted guess at where the FY OP guide ends up after this print, relative to 6,600.
positioning_check: Not on the JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-10-27 (short_ratio 0.0, no change; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Kabutan shows 信用倍率 as '－' and labels the name as margin-buy only (制度信用, not 貸借), so there is no margin short side to squeeze (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4832, 2026-10-28). There is no option skew in Japan. Run-up -0.26% over 20 days and +0.79% over 5. The stock is range-bound at 1,800-2,080 since April and sits 7% below its pre-Q1 close of 2,079. priced_lean is +0.013, effectively flat.

findings.finding: Risk of a FY guidance cut at this H1 print. Q1 OP was 802m (-51.5% YoY), 12.2% of the 6,600m plan (ordinary 13.0% against a five-year average of 21.3%). Orders fell 12.7% and the backlog 9.9%. The plan needs about 5,800m of OP over Q2-Q4, against 4,693m in the same quarters last year. The company did cut at last year's Q2 (OP 6,300 -> 5,582, 2025-10-29) and the stock fell 11.5%. Offsetting this, it called Q1 'in line with plan' and last year beat even its uncut initial plan (actual OP 6,346 vs 6,300 initial).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2025-10-29 Q2 print with an 11% FY OP cut, the stock moved -11.49% next session (baseline history, release https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251029/140120251027579709.pdf). At the 2024-10 Q2 print with no cut it moved +2.0%. At the 2026-07-29 Q1 miss with the guide held it moved -7.94%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The weak progress rate is computable by anyone from the Q1 短信 and was sold -7.9% on 2026-07-30; the stock has not recovered. What is not in the price is the binary of whether a cut comes in this release. With no consensus and no options, nobody publishes what is expected. If a cut were fully priced, the stock would trade well below its 13.8x PER on the uncut 139.5 yen EPS. Instead it sits mid-range at 1,925, so the market is holding something between 'cut' and 'hold'.
findings.independence: Shares one document family (the Q1 決算概況 and 短信) with finding 2. The track record of cuts comes from a separate document: last year's revision notice, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251029/140120251027579709.pdf, and kabutan's revision history, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4832.

findings.finding: The Q2 standalone quarter likely shows YoY OP growth against an easy comparison: Q2 last year was 1,014m at a 7.0% margin. The interim dividend set in April at 22 yen (down from 28), on a ~50% payout, implies an internal H1 plan of roughly 2,000-2,100m OP, so roughly 1,200-1,300m in Q2. The plan was back-loaded by design, which blunts the 'Q1 miss' reading.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent for a quarter beat on this name. Of the last six prints, five fell (-1.47, -11.49, -4.97, -4.79, -7.94; one, 2025-04, rose +6.22 on a dividend raise), so this name has sold its prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference from the dividend split and the payout policy, not a number the company has stated. The cumulative H1 headline will still read as a large YoY decline (vs 2,667m), which is how kabutan will frame it. So any market reading of Q2 as 'on track' arrives only with the release.
findings.independence: The payout policy (配当性向の水準を維持, 50.2%) comes from the Q1 決算概況, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260729501921.pdf: the same document family as finding 1, so the two are not independent.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet/kabutan disclosure list for 4832, 2026-08 to 2026-10-28: no 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 pre-released. October items are only the 9/29 organizational reform (a new Customer Value Promotion dept, not material) and minor product releases (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4832)
IFIS consensus: empty, no analyst coverage (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4832)
Shikiho / Toyo Keizai forecast: not found via search

Parent JFE HD (5411): H1 forecast revised upward on 2026-08-05 (final profit 2.4x), and steel stocks were rallying on US steel prices on 2026-10-20. That is macro-to-company only, with no statement on IT budgets toward JFE Systems, so it was not filed (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5411)
Buyback history: none found in kabutan's 4832 disclosure history 2025-2026. The company is parent-controlled, so a buyback is unlikely
Last two Q2/FY prints' capital returns: dividend held at the FY26/3 Q2 cut (68 yen kept), +2 yen raise to 70 at the FY guide. No 優待
release_time_source: Every print since 2025 was stamped 15:30 on kabutan/TDnet (Q1 2026-07-29 15:30, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4832&b=k202607290037; FY 2026-04-24 15:30; Q3 2026-01-28 15:30; Q2 2025-10-29 15:30). Kabutan's 10/28 schedule lists 4832 under 取引時間中の発表 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4832&b=n202610271183), which most likely reflects the 15:30 stamp coinciding with the close. Treat it as 15:30, which means close-to-close scoring.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible, down. Last year the company cut at Q2; Q1 progress is 12% vs a ~21% norm; no street bar to compare against. Returns: dividend of 70 likely held (last year held through a cut); buyback unlikely. New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 13% vs 5-yr avg 21.3% for ordinary profit; H1 likely ~30% vs 42-55% in the last three years, but the April interim dividend of 22 yen shows the plan was back-loaded by design.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Parent JFE HD improving (H1 forecast raised 2026-08-05, steel-stock inflows 2026-10-20) as a read-through to JFE Systems' steel IT revenue
rejected_candidates.detail: Filed as context only. JFE Systems' own Q1 決算概況 says steel-segment revenue fell 42% on completion of the refresh project, with follow-on projects only 'steadily progressing'. That company-level document overrides a parent-profit proxy.

baseline_tension: Positioning (no shorts, margin-long only, flat run-up) says nothing, so the findings neither agree with nor cut against it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY forecast plus the 70-yen dividend held, with Q2 OP up YoY on an easy comparison; I looked for it and it is consistent with the company's 'on plan' statement and its back-loaded interim dividend. That is why the net lean is only slightly negative.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the negative rests on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the Q1 短信, so the guidance finding was shrunk from -0.8 to -0.5. It was kept only because the release can ADD a forecast cut, which this company made at last year's Q2. p_up moved 45 -> 47.
Rule 2: wrote the strongest positive (a held forecast and dividend, Q2 YoY OP growth) into baseline_tension. It had already been searched, so p_up did not move further for this rule.
